full.description: This image is a low-magnification light micrograph of pancreatic tissue stained with hematoxylin and eosin. It shows exocrine pancreatic acinar tissue surrounding a distinct, well-circumscribed neoplastic nodule. The central mass consists of uniform, monomorphic endocrine cells arranged in cords and nests, characteristic of an islet cell tumor or neuroendocrine neoplasm. The surrounding exocrine tissue and capsule appear largely compressed by the growing mass. Based on the histologic appearance and architectural pattern, this is most consistent with an islet cell carcinoma of the pancreas.

random.description: This is a low-power histological micrograph showing a section of pancreatic tissue. The field displays exocrine pancreatic acinar tissue surrounding a prominent, well-demarcated islet of Langerhans in the center. The surrounding architecture appears largely unremarkable, highlighting normal endocrine and exocrine components of the pancreas.
